blocks.text: Public relations practitioners in Cebu and across the Visayas could gain greater access to professional training, mentorship, and career opportunities as the Public Relations Society of the Philippines (PRSP) appointed Doris Isubal-Mongaya as its first Visayas Regional Chair on October 14, 2026, at SM City Cebu. The milestone marks a step toward making the profession more accessible beyond Metro Manila, where many industry activities and development opportunities have traditionally been concentrated. Anchored on the theme “Stewarding PRSP: Amplifying Voices, Building Trust — Empowering Regions. Advancing PR Practice.
